## Diagnose section overview

The React app groups admin/diagnostic tools under **Diagnose** in the sidebar (`frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`). Routes use the `/diagnose/*` prefix; legacy Jinja URLs redirect via `app/spa.py`.

| Route | Component | File |
|-------|-----------|------|
| `/diagnose/design-system` | `DesignSystem` | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/DesignSystem.tsx` |
| `/diagnose/club-matrix` | `ClubMatrix` | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/ClubMatrix.tsx` |
| `/diagnose/liga-wochen` | `LeagueWeekMatrix` | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/LeagueWeekMatrix.tsx` |
| `/diagnose/daten-anomalien` | `DataOddities` | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/DataOddities.tsx` |

Routes are registered in `frontend/src/App.tsx`. There is no index route under `/diagnose`.

### Shared diagnosis infrastructure

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `frontend/src/components/DiagnosisToolbar.tsx` | Shared filter row (`rounded-sm border bg-surface`) |
| `frontend/src/lib/diagnosisLinks.ts` | Deep links from diagnosis into `/liga` |
| `frontend/src/hooks/useLeague.ts` | React Query hooks + types (`DIAGNOSIS_LIST_STALE_MS = 10 min`) |
| `frontend/src/components/DatabaseSelector.tsx` | Data source picker (rendered under the Diagnose nav group) |
| `frontend/src/hooks/useDatabase.ts` | Fetches source metadata |

---

## Backend endpoints

### Diagnosis-specific (Flask `app/routes/league_routes.py`)

| Endpoint | Used by | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `GET /league/get_club_matrix` | `useClubMatrix`, `useClubMatrices` | Club list + team×season matrix; `club`, `only_unnumbered` params |
| `GET /league/get_week_matrix` | `useWeekMatrix` | League×season week coverage; cells have `status`: `ok` / `warn` / `bad` / `critical` |
| `GET /league/get_data_oddities` | `useDataOddities` | Row-level anomalies; `types` param (`unnumbered_team`, `low_score`, `incomplete_row`) |

Implementation lives in `app/services/league_service.py` (`get_league_week_matrix`, `get_data_oddities`, club matrix helpers). Supporting utils:

- `app/utils/league_week_expectations.py` — expected matchday counts
- `app/utils/league_level5_merge.py` — BL/BZOL merge for week diagnosis

All three endpoints are cached (`app/cache/league_response_cache.py`) and warmed by `scripts/warm_league_cache.py`.

### Legacy redirects (`app/spa.py`)

- `/league/club_matrix` → `/diagnose/club-matrix`
- `/league/week_matrix` → `/diagnose/liga-wochen`

### Data sources (not diagnosis-named, but relevant)

In `app/routes/main.py`:

| Endpoint | Frontend usage |
|----------|----------------|
| `GET /get-data-sources-info` | `useDatabaseSelection` → `DatabaseSelector` |
| `POST /switch-database` | Session sync on source change |
| `GET /reload-data`, `GET /get-data-source`, `GET /data-source-changed` | Legacy; not used by React diagnosis pages |
| `GET /debug-session` | Debug only — session source, `data_rows`, etc.; **not wired to React** |

`database_config.get_sources_info()` (`app/config/database_config.py`) returns per-source metadata (`filename`, `display_name`, `description`, `file_path`, `is_default`, `is_enabled`). Only `db_real_merged` is exposed in the selector UI today.

There are **no Flask routes** named “diagnosis”, “pipeline”, or “health” beyond the three league endpoints above.

---

## How data health is already surfaced

**Content quality (merged published data):**

1. **Liga-Wochen** — heatmap-style matrix; missing matchdays per league×season; color-coded by `status` (`LeagueWeekMatrix.tsx` uses emerald/amber/orange/rose backgrounds).
2. **Daten-Anomalien** — filterable list of row-level issues with severity borders and deep links into Liga.
3. **Club-Matrix** — team×season placement; optional “only unnumbered teams” filter to spot naming problems.

**Operational / source context (limited):**

- **DatabaseSelector** in the Diagnose sidebar — switch active database via `?database=` + `/get-data-sources-info`.
- **Home** (`frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx`) — aggregate stats only; no pipeline health.

**Not surfaced in the UI:**

- Pipeline run status, last merge/build timestamps, stage progress
- CLI scripts (`merge_league_sources.py`, `build_published_dataset.py`, `check_input_data_issues.py`) — documented in `docs/Excel_Extraction.md` § “In the running app (React diagnosis)”
- Cache headers (`X-League-Cache: HIT/MISS` on week matrix)
- `/debug-session` row counts

Docs explicitly position app diagnosis as checks on **merged published data**, complementing CLI pipeline tools — not a pipeline dashboard.

---

## Design system conventions for new UI

**Spec:** `designsystem/design-system.md`  
**Live reference:** `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/DesignSystem.tsx`  
**Tokens:** `frontend/src/lib/design-tokens.ts`, CSS semantic vars in `frontend/src/index.css`

Existing diagnosis pages follow a consistent layout:

```tsx
// Pattern used in all four diagnosis pages
<div className="mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-4 pt-8 pb-24 lg:px-8 lg:pt-12">
  <header className="mb-6 lg:mb-8">
    <p className="text-label uppercase text-muted mb-2">Diagnose</p>  {/* eyebrow */}
    <h1 className="text-h1">…</h1>
    <p className="text-body text-muted mt-2 max-w-[72ch]">…</p>
  </header>
  <DiagnosisToolbar>{/* filters */}</DiagnosisToolbar>
  <section className="rounded-sm border border-border bg-surface …">…</section>
</div>
```

Conventions to follow:

- Semantic tokens (`bg-surface`, `text-muted`, `border-border`, `text-accent`) — no hardcoded hex in chrome
- Status via `rainbowPastel`-aligned colors (see `STATUS_COLORS` in design tokens; week matrix and oddities pages are good examples)
- Lucide icons, 16 px / stroke 1.75 in nav
- Flat surfaces with hairline borders; cards only for KPI tiles, not whole sections
- i18n via `useTranslations` with `ui.diagnosis.*` keys
- Tables: sticky headers pattern from `LeagueWeekMatrix.tsx` for dense grids

---

## Natural place for a “data pipeline” / “sources” panel

**Best fit: a fifth Diagnose page**, e.g. `/diagnose/datenquellen` or `/diagnose/pipeline`.

Why this fits:

1. **Sidebar group already exists** — add an item next to Anomalien in `Sidebar.tsx` (icon candidates: `Database`, `Workflow`, `GitBranch` from Lucide).
2. **Same page shell** — reuse `DiagnosisToolbar` + header eyebrow pattern from sibling pages.
3. **Partial backend already exists** — `/get-data-sources-info` can power a “Sources” section (display name, description, `file_path`) without new API for v1.
4. **Clear separation of concerns:**
   - *Content health* → Liga-Wochen, Anomalien, Club-Matrix (existing)
   - *Operational health* → new page: active source, file metadata, pipeline stage status, last build, link to CLI docs

**Implementation sketch (no code changes, just guidance):**

| Piece | Location |
|-------|----------|
| New page component | `frontend/src/pages/diagnosis/DataSources.tsx` or `PipelineStatus.tsx` |
| Route | `frontend/src/App.tsx` — `/diagnose/datenquellen` |
| Nav entry | `frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx` — Diagnose group |
| Hook (v1) | Extend `useDatabase.ts` or add `usePipelineStatus.ts` |
| Hook (v2) | New Flask endpoint e.g. `GET /pipeline/status` in `app/routes/main.py` returning merge timestamps, parquet mtime, row counts |

**Alternative (weaker):** Expand the `DatabaseSelector` block at the bottom of the Diagnose nav — works for source switching but is too cramped for pipeline stages, build history, or anomaly summaries.

**Related doc:** `docs/Excel_Extraction.md` lines 262–269 maps UI routes to APIs and describes the pipeline ↔ diagnosis relationship; a new panel could link there for operator runbooks.
